item.title: Caprice Resources Continues to Deepen the Vadrians System at its Island Gold Project
item.description: Caprice Resources (ASX: CRS) has confirmed gold mineralisation to at least 400m vertical depth with Phase 4 drilling at the Vadrians prospect within its Island gold project in Western Australia’s Murchison region.

item.title: International Graphite Receives Encouraging Projections for Proposed German EGF JV
item.description: A techno-economic evaluation has provided International Graphite (ASX: IG6) with solid financial projections for its proposed expandable graphite facility (EGF) joint venture in Germany.

item.title: Leeuwin Metals Outlines Maiden MRE at Marda Project in WA Ahead of January Drilling Program
item.description: Leeuwin Metals (ASX: LM1) has reported a maiden Mineral Resource Estimate for its Marda gold project in Western Australia just nine months after the company acquired the project, following drilling, geophysics, and geochemistry programs.

item.title: Rox Resources Transitions to Round-the-Clock Gold Mining Operations at Youanmi’s United North Pit
item.description: Rox Resources (ASX: RXL) has transitioned to 24-hour mining at the United North pit within its Youanmi gold project in Western Australia.

item.title: Black Canyon Completes Drilling Program and Heritage Survey at Wandanya Manganese Project
item.description: Black Canyon (ASX: BCA) continues to rapidly advance its high-grade Wandanya manganese and iron discovery in Western Australia, completing a drilling program and heritage survey prior to the start of the region’s wet season.

item.title: Volt Resources Signs Funding Deal for Bunyu Graphite Mine in Tanzania
item.description: Volt Resources (ASX: VRC) has announced a funding agreement for the development of the Bunyu graphite mine and processing plant in Tanzania, with the Cayman Islands-based Unbounded Opportunities Fund to invest approximately $17.6 million (US$11.1m).

item.title: Aurora Labs Receives Maiden Order to Deploy AU4 Propulsion Engines for UAV Field Testing
item.description: Aurora Labs (ASX: A3D) has received a $250,000 maiden purchase order from Australian company Sovereign Propulsion Systems for the supply of 20 of the company's AU4 propulsion engines.

item.title: Hot Chili Hits Shallow, High-Grade Copper Mineralisation at La Verde Discovery in Chile
item.description: Hot Chili (ASX: HCH) has confirmed shallow, high-grade porphyry-style copper mineralisation at its La Verde discovery in Chile, highlighting the potential for a significant up-dip expansion to La Verde’s gold-rich core.

item.title: Pursuit Minerals Finalises Acquisition of Sascha Marcelina Gold-Silver Project
item.description: Pursuit Minerals (ASX: PUR) has settled on a binding agreement to acquire the Sascha Marcelina gold-silver project in Argentina’s Santa Cruz precious metals province.

item.title: Strickland Metals Outlines Maiden Gold Resource at Gradina as Rogozna Growth Continues
item.description: Strickland Metals (ASX: STK) has delivered a maiden Inferred Mineral Resource Estimate of 1.2 million ounces of gold for the Gradina deposit at its Rogozna project in Serbia.
